title: Holiday Card Send Cards Sent Leaderboard
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holiday:card cards_sent=*
| stats sum(cards_sent) as total_value, avg(cards_sent) as avg_value by card_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks card type values by total and average cards sent across holiday card send events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `cards_sent` values for each holiday card send event and review total and average cards sent by card type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total cards sent.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which card type shows the biggest cards sent numbers in your holiday card send data.
